ad_library.summary: Visionteknewenergy is running 11 distinct live Meta creatives, every one of them started on 12 Nov 2026 except a Diwali creative from 6 Nov 2026 - a single coordinated launch, which means this is a fresh, actively managed account rather than a stale one. Meta groups them, reporting '2 ads use this creative and text' on each, so the real number of ads is higher than the number of distinct IDs. Six of the eleven send the click to a bare instagram.com root and one to fb.me; the rest carry no outbound link at all. Google Ads Transparency for visiontek.solar returns 0 ads under region=IN, so Meta is the entire paid channel.

funnel.destination: instagram.com root on 6 creatives, fb.me on 1, none on 4
funnel.meaning: Almost none of this spend can reach a page the company controls. The instagram.com links land on the Instagram home feed, not a profile, a post or a message thread - a click there has nowhere to go and cannot be attributed. Four creatives carry no link at all.

findings: Eleven distinct creatives, all launched on the same day (12 Nov 2026) with one from 6 Nov. Volume is not the problem here - coordination and destination are.

Six of the eleven point at a bare instagram.com root and one at fb.me. A click on instagram.com lands on the Instagram home feed, not on anything belonging to Visiontek, so that traffic is effectively unattributable.

The copy is generic brand awareness - 'Switch to Visiontek Solar', 'Big on performance. Compact in design.' - with no price, no subsidy figure, no system size and no offer anywhere across eleven creatives.

The ads sell inverters and storage (RISE+, FUTURE+, VAULT+, PULSE+) as much as they sell rooftop solar. That matches the business - this is a manufacturer's solar division launched in 2025, not a rooftop EPC - but it means the ad programme is building product awareness rather than generating installation enquiries.
visiontek.solar has a working contact form, WhatsApp support, four documented product lines and a blog posted on 11 and 12 Nov 2026 - and almost none of the paid traffic is pointed at any of it.
Zero Google ads under region=IN, so the entire paid presence is these eleven Meta creatives.
next_steps: Point the ads at something Visiontek owns

Every instagram.com and fb.me destination should become a real page - a product page for the inverter creatives, an enquiry page for the bill-saving ones. As it stands the spend cannot be measured or retargeted.
Add a number to the copy
Eleven creatives and not one price, subsidy figure or system size. Even a starting price or the PM Surya Ghar subsidy amount gives the ad something to be judged on.
Split the two audiences the copy is mixing
Some creatives sell inverters to people who already know what an inverter is; others sell rooftop solar to homeowners. They are different buyers and are currently competing in the same account.
Use the blog and the WhatsApp button
Two posts published on 11 and 12 Nov 2026 and a live WhatsApp button on every page - the ads could be driving to either of those instead of to Instagram's home feed.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
